versions.subject: Merge PR #4427 from @nasbench - Multiple Fixes & Enhancements
versions.detection:
# /c net user /add SafeMode DarkGate0!
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'user'
        - 'add'
        - 'DarkGate'
        - 'SafeMode'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="*user*" CommandLine="*add*" CommandLine="*DarkGate*" CommandLine="*SafeMode*"
